meta.name: boot-dev-companion
meta.description: Navigate boot.dev courses for game development. Use when planning learning paths, mapping boot.dev progress to game-dev readiness, choosing which courses to prioritize, or connecting platform content to the game project. Bridges backend-focused curriculum with game dev goals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把游戏开发目标对应到精选学习路径，规划课程优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在跟着 boot.dev 学后端，却想尽快转向游戏开发。
copy.tagline_en: Turn game dev goals into a prioritized boot.dev learning path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're studying backend on boot.dev but aiming to get into game development.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你筛选 boot.dev 课程里对做游戏真正有用的部分,排出优先级;还会把你的学习进度对应到「能开始学游戏引擎」等能力门槛,并给出每周搭配游戏项目的学习安排。
howto.when: 当你提到 boot.dev、想把课程进度对接游戏开发,或纠结哪些课对做游戏优先时,它就会接管。

say.text: 我刚开始做游戏,先学 boot.dev 的哪几门课?
say.note: Claude 会按 Tier 1 优先级排出课程顺序。

say.text: 我学完了 OOP 和 Asteroids,现在能开始学 Godot 了吗?
say.note: Claude 会对照能力门槛,告诉你现在到哪一步了。

say.text: 我在学 SQL,这门课对做游戏重要吗?要不要先跳过?
say.note: Claude 会判断是否游戏相关,并建议要不要暂停。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude filters boot.dev courses relevant to game dev, ranks them by priority, maps your progress to readiness gates (e.g., can start a game engine), and suggests weekly learning plans integrated with your game project.
howto.when_en: When you mention boot.dev, want to map course progress to game-dev readiness, or are deciding which courses to prioritize for a game project.

say_en.text: I'm starting to make a game. Which boot.dev courses should I take first?
say_en.note: Claude lists the Tier 1 courses in priority order.

say_en.text: I finished OOP and Asteroids. Can I start learning Godot now?
say_en.note: It checks the readiness gates and tells you your stage.

say_en.text: I'm learning SQL. Is it important for my game? Should I pause it?
say_en.note: Claude says if it's game-relevant and what to do.
